decision.risk_assessment: Extremely low volatility and volume across both BTC and ETH. ADX readings well below 20 indicate absence of directional trend, presenting elevated chop risk.
decision.reasoning: Both BTC and ETH are in tight consolidation around their EMAs with neutral momentum (RSI near 50, MACD flat) and ADX showing no established trend (14.2 for BTC, 9.7 for ETH). Volume is virtually zero. Given the trend-following strategy and recent consecutive losses, staying in cash until clear breakout volume and momentum emerge is the prudent risk management decision.
